name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 4 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-01-15, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 5 moving objects.
